_comment: Context menu configuration. registrar.py reads this — no registry logic is hardcoded in Python.

relay.content_template:
@echo off
setlocal DisableDelayedExpansion
set /p SANDBOX_ROOT=<"%~dp0{root_file}"
if exist "%SANDBOX_ROOT%\_sys\start.bat" goto :launch
set /p SANDBOX_ROOT=<"%~dp0{physroot_file}"
:launch
cd /d "%SANDBOX_ROOT%" || goto :fail
call ".\_sys\start.bat" "%~1"
exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%
:fail
echo [Error] Sandbox root not found: %SANDBOX_ROOT%
exit /b 1
